claims: The exact frozen build-10 source archived successfully and the signed-archive inspection passed for the phone app, phone widget, Watch app and Watch widget.

The archive contains matching version and build metadata, expected bundle identifiers and architectures, valid signatures, source-reconciled entitlements and privacy manifests, and matching dSYMs for all four components.

The App Store distribution export could not be produced because command-line Xcode reported No Accounts and no iOS Distribution certificate; the authenticated Organizer fallback is inaccessible while the Mac is locked.
No IPA upload, App Store build processing, build attachment or App Review submission is claimed by this blocked attempt.
limitations: The development-signed archive is not a substitute for a successful App Store distribution export and upload validation.
Resume requires the owner to unlock the Mac so the authenticated Xcode Organizer and App Store Connect sessions can be used; unchanged locked state will not be polled.
Physical-device acceptance, App Review approval and public release remain distinct and are not claimed.

authorityReference.reference: On 2026-09-07 the owner requested that the latest app with all changes made today be built and submitted to the App Store.
